note: Supplemental region seeds for the 3D board's plate partition, in RuneScape surface coordinates (x east, y north) — the same space as src/map/data/gameCoords.ts. These are rendering hints, never league data. Every place anchor already seeds its own region; these only cover stretches of land no anchor is near, so the partition does not hand an empty moor to whichever town happens to be closest across a mountain range. Offshore packs: Ashdale + Iron Enclave (asgarnia; quest primary_region). Soul Wars surface island ~2210,2890 west of Feldip is MISTHALIN (user ruling for Equilibrium — dense seeds so the landmass does not split between tirannwn/kandarin; never place Misthalin seeds on The Lost Grove island ~1860-2040,3040-3260). Tirannwn plate = Prif + Isafdar + Lost Grove + Port Tyras; cuts off at Arandar pass entrance (wiki map 2345,3283 — Kandarin owns the gate/pass eastward) and ends on the SE brown-rock edge of Isafdar (~2310-2350,3070-3100), not into Feldip/Kandarin. Brimhaven NW coast islets reclaim (karamja; Holy Grail whistle tower coast).
